authored.observedEffect: Pinned compiler and assembler controls emit all sixteen switch entries at the retail offsets, including the shared 7/8 and 10/11/12 destinations, with 4580 bytes/1145 instructions and frame 112. The state-9 amount branch reproduces retail's lbu v0; lbu v1; move a1,v0; sltu; bnel; move a1,v1 pocket. Authenticated watch D819B88115C184E8216C84C860D239B0BBE78565D1F1A08910F14C0A68DC456A classifies PURE_C with zero expected-only and actual-only instructions, 2251 differing symbolic bytes, and score 69.79, versus EEDB25F8's 2681 differing bytes and score 57.79.
authored.remainingFailure: The object is still broadly nonexact in opcodes, control flow and register allocation. The case-4 first helper argument is still hoisted into the branch delay rather than matching retail's per-branch lui/jal-delay load. The D_80219F08 name is an independent view of the same selected-ID word used to preserve the observed reload, not a semantic name claim. The 16-entry table lacks an approved auxiliary ownership contract. Original ASM remains production and no canonical linked result or completed-wave verifier has run.
authored.sourceChange: In state 4, read the selected ID separately inside each helper-call branch instead of holding one pre-branch local. In state 9, assign an explicit amount in both branches before the quantity helper. In states 10-12, keep the menu helper's 32-bit result as a word-sized local and read the selected-ID word through its observed global address for the slot store.
